text.tuskerRumour: Something huge has been tearing up the clearings. Its ground is marked on your map (M).
text.tuskerWake: The ground shakes: the Old Tusker. Its hide turns blades — lure its charge into a tree or rock, then strike.
text.tuskerHintLure: Lure its charge into something solid
text.tuskerDefeated: The Old Tusker falls. Its great tusk is yours — craft a tusk spear at a workbench.
text.stormWarning: A great storm breaks in {s}s: lightning will strike the open ground. Take shelter or stand by a fire!
text.stormPassed: The storm passes. You weathered the Great Storm.
text.blightStart: A blight grips the Heart Tree. Hold fire to its three cores to burn them, and dodge the strikes.
text.blightCleared: The blight withers away. The Heart Tree breathes again — you may make your offering.
text.blightBlocked: A blight chokes the Heart Tree. Burn its three cores with fire first.
text.blightRetry: The blight overwhelms you… you wake at the glade's edge. Burned cores stay burned. Try again.
